findings.label: Branch is behind main (rebase gap)
findings.detail: The branch merge-base is 52c0054 but main is at 73bd4d2, so `git diff main` surfaces main's error-boundary + queue cancel-confirm commit as spurious deletions. The feature commit 7736a3d touches only the twelve in-scope T-OUTBOX files and reverts nothing. Rebase onto current main before merge so the diff reflects only the feature.
